finish_summary: Bulk discount percent incorrectly returns 5% for quantity 50 (spec says 10%). Parse coupon is case-sensitive and does not trim whitespace, but spec allows both. Cart.items() returns a dict of name -> (unit_price, quantity) instead of the expected format of the module; however our test expected that format so failures are due to implementation mismatch. Removing items decrements quantity correctly but returns quantity instead of tuple. Total calculation logic misapplies discounts and shipping rounding compared to spec.
